title: Data Analyst
jd: We are hiring a Data Analyst for our retail analytics team in Bengaluru. You will build dashboards in Tableau and Power BI, write SQL queries against our warehouse and automate reports with Python (Pandas). Requirements: 1-3 years of experience, strong SQL, Tableau or Power BI, Excel. Nice to have: dbt, Airflow.

title: Backend Engineer (Python)
jd: Backend Engineer, payments platform. Build REST APIs with Python and FastAPI, PostgreSQL and Redis; deploy on AWS with Docker and Kubernetes. 3-5 years of backend experience required. Experience with Kafka is a plus.

title: Machine Learning Engineer - LLMs
jd: Join our GenAI team to fine-tune large language models. You will run SFT and RLHF pipelines in PyTorch, evaluate models and serve them. Must have: Python, PyTorch, transformers, experience with LLM fine-tuning. Good to have: LangChain, vector databases. Minimum 2 years of ML experience.

title: Frontend Developer
jd: Frontend Developer to build our customer dashboard. React, TypeScript, HTML and CSS are required. You should know REST APIs and Git. Bonus: Next.js, Tailwind CSS. 2+ years.

title: Graduate Engineer Trainee - Mechanical
jd: Graduate Engineer Trainee (Mechanical) for our manufacturing plant in Pune. Freshers welcome (0-1 years). Knowledge of AutoCAD and SolidWorks required; exposure to GD&T preferred.

title: DevOps Engineer
jd: DevOps Engineer: manage CI/CD with GitHub Actions and Jenkins, infrastructure as code with Terraform on AWS/GCP, containers with Docker and Kubernetes, monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana. 4-7 years of experience.

title: Business Analyst
jd: Business Analyst for a fintech startup. Gather requirements from stakeholders, write user stories in Jira, analyse data with SQL and Excel. Strong communication skills required. Experience in payments or lending is preferred. 2-4 years.

title: Java Developer
jd: Java Developer (Spring Boot, microservices). Required: Java 17, Spring Boot, Hibernate, MySQL, REST, unit testing with JUnit. Nice: Kafka, AWS. Experience: 5+ years.

title: Data Scientist
jd: Data Scientist to build churn and forecasting models. Python, scikit-learn, statistics, SQL; experience deploying models is required. Deep learning experience (TensorFlow or PyTorch) is a plus. 2-5 years.
